title: Transparency Disclosures for Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
abstract: arXiv:2611.13873v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is one of the most valuable tools for monitoring advanced AI systems, but it is under threat. We argue that frontier AI developers should report specific indicators to make these threats trackable and to better facilitate coordination to preserve CoT monitorability. We identify five indicators that are both highly relevant and reasonably feasible to disclose, one for each link in a five-step chain on which CoT monitoring depends. The first, third-party CoT access and base architecture specifications, also underpins external verification of the rest. The others span CoT quality (naturalness and faithfulness) and monitoring effectiveness (detection and uplift). An audit of current disclosures by Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google DeepMind shows that no developer covers the full set, but that every indicator has been reported by at least one frontier developer. translated_title: 面向思维链可监控性的透明度披露
translated_abstract: 思维链（CoT）监控是监控先进AI系统最有价值的工具之一，但它正面临威胁。我们认为，前沿AI开发者应当报告特定的指标，使这些威胁变得可追踪，并更好地促进保护思维链可监控性的协调合作。我们识别出五个既高度相关又合理可行的披露指标，思维链监控所依赖的五步链条中每个环节各对应一个指标。第一个指标——第三方思维链访问权限与基础架构规范——同时也为其余指标的外部验证提供支撑。其余指标涵盖思维链质量（自然性与忠实性）和监控有效性（检测能力与能力提升）。对Anthropic、OpenAI和Google DeepMind当前披露情况的审计显示，没有任何开发者覆盖了全部指标，但每个指标都至少被一家前沿开发者报告过。由于当前的披露主要依赖于开发者的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出覆盖思维链访问、质量（自然性与忠实性）和监控有效性（检测与能力提升）的五个透明度披露指标，呼吁前沿AI开发者定期报告这些指标以保护思维链监控能力免受威胁，审计显示目前尚无开发者覆盖全部五个指标。
